extract_coco_annotations: extract COCO 2014 train keypoints and bounding boxes from annotations JSON to an NPZ file
export_to_spin_format: export 3D pose estimation results from a pickle file to SPIN-compatible NPZ database format
convert_coco_joints_to_global: convert COCO 17-joint keypoints to a 24-joint global ordering for SPIN compatibility
compute_bbox_center_and_scale: compute bounding box center coordinates and normalized scale factor from annotation bounding boxes
map_2d_keypoints_to_spin24: map 26-joint 2D pose keypoints to the 24-joint SPIN skeleton format with validity flags
